description: Add a scoped write surface to the Admin Dashboard for adding a new Guest. An admin-session-gated endpoint appends a row to the Guests tab using the service account's write scope, minting the next guest_id server-side, with a form offering an existing-party selector or a freshly minted party_id for a new couple, plus side and plus_one_allowed. The new Guest can pass the gate immediately (live read). Scope is add-only — editing or removing a Guest still happens in the Sheet. HITL because it lands the scoped relaxation of the read-only-admin contract and must not merge before the context-grill updates CONTEXT.md and TEAM_DIRECTIVE.
title: Admin add-guest write surface
acceptance_criteria: An admin-gated form/endpoint appends a Guest row to the Guests tab and mints the next guest_id
The form lets the admin attach to an existing party or mint a new party_id, and set side and plus_one_allowed
A Guest added via admin can pass the gate without a redeploy
Only appending to the Guests tab is permitted; RSVP data and guest-facing content remain read-only
Does not merge until the context-grill has updated CONTEXT.md and TEAM_DIRECTIVE for the relaxed contract
